drift_monitoring.interpretation: PSI thresholds are heuristic monitoring thresholds.

governance_rule.step_1: Monitor feature and fraud-rate distribution drift.
governance_rule.step_2: Trigger adaptation only when meaningful drift is detected.
governance_rule.step_3: Train an adaptation candidate using information available at the adaptation time.
governance_rule.step_4: Evaluate the candidate on temporally subsequent validation data.
governance_rule.step_5: Deploy the candidate only if predefined forward-performance gates are satisfied.
governance_rule.step_6: Otherwise retain the stronger frozen detector.

reason: Both naive retraining and fixed recency weighting degraded future fraud-detection performance.
safety_principle: Adaptation must never automatically replace a stronger validated detector.
